news.title: ECE's Li elected 2027 Optica Fellow
news.summary_en: Optica has announced their 2027 Fellows class on October 23, 2026. Tongcang Li, of Purdue University, was elected a fellow for pioneering contributions to nanoscale optical quantum sensing using spin defects in two-dimensional materials and levitated optomechanics.

news.title: New erosion rig at Purdue will help make the Navy's jet engines more durable
news.summary_en: The new Purdue High-speed Automated Sand Erosion Rig (PHASER) is a next-generation machine for studying new ways to help engines endure what the U.S. Navy calls "austere environments" — like a full-power takeoff on a desert airfield.

news.title: Purdue, Sandia National Labs launch engineering master's program to strengthen hypersonics workforce
news.summary_en: A group of Purdue University aerospace engineering students is getting a head start in hypersonic flight by enrolling in a first-of-its-kind program: a specialized master's degree in hypersonics developed jointly by Purdue and Sandia National Laboratories.
